item.description:
New in 0.1.4

  • Settings. TimeCal gets a Settings window (⌘,). Choose the snap increment for painting, dragging, and creating (5 to 60 minutes), set the default duration for double-click events, and shape the feel of the wheel: zoom or pan, direction, and speed. Every change applies instantly.
  • Calendar accounts. Adding Google, iCloud, or Exchange accounts now has a front door: Settings → Accounts, or Add Account in the sidebar's + menu. Both open macOS Internet Accounts, and TimeCal picks up new calendars automatically.
  • Typing stays typing. Keyboard shortcuts no longer fire while you edit inside an event's details. Typing P in an AM/PM field now sets PM instead of opening Bookmarks.
  • Room to breathe. The Guide is a two-column cheat sheet with everything visible at once, and the Settings window fits its content with no scrolling.
  • Acknowledgments. The About panel credits Sparkle, the open-source framework behind TimeCal's updates.

Feedback

Send anything, bugs, ideas, confusion, to evan@sandpipermediagroup.com.
